title: Fish Audio Drama 3 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.18010v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Fish Audio Drama 3, an open-source speech generation model that turns text into directed performances, built on a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts backbone that activates 3B parameters per token. It clones voices from multiple references, follows natural-language direction, revises a take when the next turn gives a note, voices multi-character scenes, edits existing speech by infilling, and synthesizes long-form and streaming audio. Multi-turn revision, scene dubbing, editing by infilling, and streaming text input are new in Drama 3, all in one model. Drama 3 pairs the hybrid linear-attention backbone with a new codebook multi-token-prediction audio decoder that predicts the acoustic codebooks of each frame in dedicated layers that attend over the entire sequence. translated_title: Fish Audio Drama 3 技术报告
translated_abstract: 我们推出 Fish Audio Drama 3，这是一个开源语音生成模型，能够将文本转化为有导演指导的表演。该模型基于 350 亿参数的混合专家架构骨干网络，每个 token 激活 30 亿参数。它可以从多个参考样本克隆声音，遵循自然语言导演指令，在下一轮收到反馈意见时修改录音片段，为多角色场景配音，通过填充方式编辑现有语音，并合成长篇和流式音频。多轮修改、场景配音、填充编辑和流式文本输入均是 Drama 3 的新功能，且全部集成于同一个模型中。Drama 3 将混合线性注意力骨干网络与一种新的码本多 token 预测音频解码器相结合，该解码器通过专门关注整个序列的层来预测每一帧的声学码本。该模型采用三阶段预训练方案、指令微调以及大批量强化学习进行训练，其唯一的奖励是单个……
tldr: Fish Audio Drama 3 是一个基于 35B 参数混合专家架构的开源语音生成模型，能将文本转化为有导演指导的表演，并首次在单一模型中集成了多轮修改、场景配音、填充编辑和流式输入等多项新能力。
en_tdlr: Fish Audio Drama 3 is an open-source 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts speech generation model that turns text into directed performances, uniquely integrating multi-turn revision, scene dubbing, infilling-based editing, and streaming input within a single model.
